messages:
alex: heads up — we're bumping up GPU capacity for the next quarter. current plan leans heavily on spot in us-west-2. want to align on bid strategy + interruption handling. any strong opinions?
priya: fwiw our last spike saw a lot of reclamations around 02:00 UTC, mostly p4d and g4dn. lot of churn. :grimacing:
josh: yeah, p4d spot is volatile. for critical batches we used capacity-optimized pools and it helped reduce churn by ~30% last month.
marta: can you share the failure patterns? are drops instantaneous or graceful SIGTERM windows?
alex: mostly 2-min warning on aws, sometimes none. logs show kubelet eviction then pods get rescheduled but checkpointing wasn't consistent.
priya: our takeaway — mixed pools + checkpointing + short-lived state persisted to S3 works best. for training jobs we added model.saver checkpoints every 2k steps, reduced wasted work.
josh: on strategy: capacity-optimized over price-optimized when you care about continuity. price-optimized can be cheaper but more interruptions. suggestion: mix them by workload tier. e.g., dev/experiments => price-optimized, prod-batch/low-latency => capacity-optimized. :white_check_mark:
marta: agree. also use instance diversification — mix GPU family types (a100/p4/rtx) and families on multiple AZs to avoid single-AZ scarcity.
alex: how do we automate bidding? currently we set maxPrice = on-demand for aws spot to avoid sudden eviction when price spikes. that's expensive. any better heuristics?
priya: instead of full on-demand cap, try a percentile-based cap: monitor historical spot price for 90 days and set maxPrice = 95th percentile. then combine with capacity-optimized allocation strategy. that keeps cost down but avoids the worst spikes.
josh: good rule. also use fallback policies: if spot acquisition fails for X minutes, fallback to reserved/dedicated small buffer pool to keep SLA. autoscaler should provision small on-demand pool as overflow.
marta: for GCP preemptible: fixed price but 24h max lifespan. consider job checkpoint cadence to handle 24h expiry. also preemptions still happen earlier.
alex: any autoscaler config examples?
priya: we use k8s cluster-autoscaler with multiple nodegroups. sample snippet: `--balance-similar-node-groups --expander=least-waste --skip-nodes-with-local-storage=false`. nodegroups are labeled by pool-type=spot/capopt/priceopt and autoscaler scales them independently.
josh: plus add a simple policy in the job runner: attempt_spot=true; max_spot_retries=3; on_retry_fallback_to="spot-capopt,spot-priceopt,on-demand". that sequence is important.
marta: interruption handling: subscribe to cloud spot/instance termination notices; on AWS use the two-minute metadata notification and call `/opt/terminate-hook` that triggers graceful checkpoint + k8s eviction. for TF training we call saver.save() then drain node.
alex: infra-bot can we add a health dashboard widget for spot eviction rate per instance type and AZ? need a daily digest.
infra-bot: scheduled — added alert template "spot-eviction-rate" to the eng-infra dashboard; will post daily summary to #eng-infra at 07:00 UTC.
priya: cost angle: run experiments to compare price-optimized vs capacity-optimized over 30 days. measure effective cost-per-successful-step (cost / completed-steps) not raw $/hour. interruptions blow up effective cost.
josh: also consider committing to a small Dedicated baseline for p99-critical paths and supplement with spot for elasticity. commit size can be tuned to hit desired p99 latency.
marta: region fallback: if us-west-2 is saturated, have a policy to spill to us-west-1 or eu-west-1 only for batch jobs. be conservative for low-latency prod traffic due to cross-region networking.
alex: thanks — actionable: (1) implement percentile-based maxPrice + capacity-optimized preference, (2) autoscaler nodegroups per pool-type + fallback order, (3) checkpoint cadence + termination-hook, (4) dashboard eviction digest. i'll file a follow-up RFC. can someone volunteer to draft the RFC?
priya: i'll take the RFC draft. will include experiment plan and metrics.
josh: i'll pair on autoscaler nodegroup config.
marta: i'll own termination-hook docs and runbook.
alex: perfect — let's sync next Tue. :rocket:
